title: Stable live slot layout during data arrivals and refresh
description: Read only. Select a connected owned Agent Chrome tab on a live slot/run and authenticated automation profile. FARMSLOT_SLOT_LAYOUT_{TAB,SLOT,RUN,OUTPUT}, FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT. Captures actual browser video, reads run.get, reloads the page, and verifies geometry and mounted element identities. No worker, lifecycle action or UI state injection.

stable-slot.intent: Prove the live slot workspace does not move or remount when reads arrive or the page refreshes.
